'''Nenneb''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] engineer who worked for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. He was sent to represent the company at the [[Cularin Trade Show]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and he exhibited their [[GLX Firelance|Firelance blaster rifle]] there.
